clauses.reason: First end 1987-06-17 by EO 12598 (President Reagan), Sec. 6: "Executive Order No. 12576 of December 2,1986, is hereby superseded." Section 1 of EO 12576 delegated the section 803 (5 U.S.C. 5569) functions to the Secretary of State for individuals captive on or before January 21, 1981; EO 12598 Sec. 1 delegates the section 803(a) functions at 5 U.S.C. 5569 to the Secretary of State without that date limit, so the earlier delegation is replaced.

First end 1987-06-17 by EO 12598, Sec. 6: "Executive Order No. 12576 of December 2,1986, is hereby superseded." Section 2 of EO 12576 delegated the section 806 (37 U.S.C. 559) functions to the Secretary of Defense for individuals captive on or before January 21, 1981; EO 12598 Sec. 3 delegates section 806(a) (37 U.S.C. 559) and further functions to the Secretary of Defense, so the earlier delegation is replaced.

First end 1987-06-17 by EO 12598, Sec. 6: "Executive Order No. 12576 of December 2,1986, is hereby superseded." Section 3 of EO 12576 required the Secretaries of State and Defense to consult each other and other agencies in carrying out the functions; EO 12598 Sec. 5 imposes the same consultation duty in carrying out their functions under that order, so the earlier duty is replaced.

research_rationale:
EO 12576 (Dec. 2, 1986) delegated to the Secretary of State the President's functions under section 803 of the Act (5 U.S.C. 5569) and to the Secretary of Defense those under section 806 (37 U.S.C. 559), each for paying compensation to individuals held in captive status commencing on or before January 21, 1981, and directed the two Secretaries to consult (Secs. 1-3). EO 12598 (signed June 17, 1987; 52 FR 23421, Monday, June 22, 1987), issued to implement the same Title VIII of Public Law 99-399, restates the delegations of section 803(a) functions (5 U.S.C. 5569) to the Secretary of State (Sec. 1) and of section 806(a) functions (37 U.S.C. 559) to the Secretary of Defense (Sec. 3), repeats the consultation duty (Sec. 5) and states "Executive Order No. 12576 of December 2,1986, is hereby superseded." (Sec. 6). The delegations are therefore replaced, not merely ended: express supersession is the first end of all three clauses on 1987-06-17 (EO 12598 has no separate effective-date clause, so it operates from its signing date; the Federal Register publication date, June 22, 1987, is not the effective date). The order has no term of its own and no earlier end was found in the held sources; the OFR catalog records Superseded by EO 12598, June 17, 1987.

savings.reason: The functions were delegated, not performed once: EO 12598 Secs. 1, 3 and 5 re-delegate the same section 803 and 806 functions to the same Secretaries and repeat the consultation duty, so the delegated authority was transferred rather than extinguished. Compensation already paid under EO 12576 is an accrued effect that EO 12598 does not undo. No held source shows an independent continuing command in EO 12576.
